steps.name: Prepare verified Arch image and ephemeral access
Transfer exact checkout and Go, then run guest validation

initial_attempt.result: Harness stopped before command cgroup/root workloads: Getxattr(user.delegate) returned ENODATA. The marker is system-manager-only in systemd v261.3; corrected harness asserts Delegate=yes, Transient=yes and exact ControlGroup through user manager, then verifies actual filesystem authority. No permission/environment changes. Sudo revoked and disposable VM removed.

user_manager: running; 0 failed units; existing SSH/PAM runtime bus
sudo_extra_monitors: No additional sudo monitor/PTY process observed in recursive snapshots of these non-TTY cases. Every enumerated PID, including effective-UID-0 sudo, was verified absent after kill. This is not an interactive sudo-PTY proof.
fork_bound: 10 trials; maximum 8 nonrecursive forker children plus fixed root helper/child/grandchild/forker fixture; gate after first 2, kill during unfinished 6-fork interval after fork-2 readiness. Observed 3 fork children per trial. Finite scheduling evidence, not exhaustive race proof.
termination_bound: 8-second polling/channel bounds; controller and helpers also expire at 45 seconds. All observed kill-to-completed-termination checks took 106-107 ms including 100 ms heartbeat stability sample.
normal_ci: PASS: namespace/bwrap, native Arch/Flatpak, formatting/vet, full ordinary and race suites, skip audits, build/shell validation
malicious_root_boundary: Intentional cgroup manipulation by UID 0 or same UID is excluded. Trusted ordinary sudo/pacman/hooks/build descendants are lifecycle-owned; this is not a malicious-code sandbox.
manager_boundary: Directly forked/detached daemons inherit and are killed; independently systemd/PID-1 spawned services are manager-owned and may outlive command. No real services started by proof helpers.
